name: Layout Composer
description: Cartographic print layout designer for GeoLibre: page-size catalog in mm/cm/in/pt/px, live map frames with locked scale, custom shapes and per-frame layers, DMS/DD/UTM grids, inset maps, legends for vector, raster and tile layers, attribute tables and charts from layer data, matplotlib-style color bars, dual-unit scale bars, 26 north arrows, LaTeX, drawing tools, Google Fonts and Material Symbols, Maki and Temaki icons, layout grids and precise editing, QGIS .qpt import/export, user templates, and PNG/JPG/PDF/vector PDF/GeoPDF/SVG export.
author: Defani Arman Alfitriansyah
